name: Crushes & Curses
source:
As a novice mage cursed with lost memories, you can’t remember how to wield your magic. In search of answers, you find yourself at Tara’s Tavern.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你是一名初學魔法的法師，受了詛咒，丟了記憶，連自己的魔法該怎麼用都忘了。為尋找答案，你來到了塔拉的酒館。

［取自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian App[/url]］
